name: SITC2026 S17 - Module C
description: Build a deterministic SwapLoop Main Backend REST API for a fictional Shanghai e-bike battery swapping and monitored charging pilot. Implement opaque bearer auth, station discovery, unified swap/charging services with 15-minute holds, Station Service last-charge safety and live bike-bay charging, pay-as-you-go price snapshots, and a resettable MySQL seed; verify behaviour against the supplied OpenAPI contract and Bruno suite.
